selection: Every 71st source row (starting at row 0) across all 13,979,592 records; 196,896 real observations. Systematic subset, not the complete dataset or a simple random sample.
notes: Attribution: Eustache Diemert, Artem Betlei, Christophe Renaudin, Massih-Reza Amini / Criteo AI Lab, A Large Scale Benchmark for Uplift Modeling (2018). Original feature/treatment/outcome columns are retained. Exclude post-treatment exposure from pre-treatment modeling. Respect v2.1 sampling/design notes; observed incrementality is not the originating company's population effect. Projects 02 and 07 intentionally share this source subset but answer different questions.
